preparation_kind: Recovered vector membership using all 100,000 cached embeddings; no fresh-candidate ingest/inference throughput

definitions.logical_active_vector_payload_bytes: active passages multiplied by 384 float32 components
definitions.logical_history_bytes: distinct version content blobs not referenced by an active head
definitions.logical_live_bytes: distinct content blobs referenced by active document heads
definitions.logical_total_vector_payload_bytes: cached plus active logical vector payloads; excludes SQLite and sqlite-vec page overhead

limits: Performance observation and explicit cached recovery only; no full fresh-preparation qualification.
Different candidate from Linux baseline and Linux stress; no same-candidate platform or causal before/after performance comparison.
No CPU frequency, thermal, background-process or page-fault telemetry was collected, so timing trends cannot prove environmental causes.

Full response bytes are not retained by compact harness observations; the existing field/mode/result integrity checks were enforced during execution, while raw model/index checks are bound to the recorded Doctor and model verification.
Stage timers overlap for body materialization and exact fallback; the unassigned remainder is not attribution to a measured operation.
